messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Sat 21 Nov
Barça play Villarreal at the Camp Nou on Sunday at 14:00, so Les Corts will be packed around midday. No confirmed Argentine night this weekend.

TODAY · Sat 21 Nov

1. [Last 100 tickets] Jackies Open Air Daytime - Closing 2026 Season La Terrrazza
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 03:00 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 844 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €28–580
💬 Season-closing open-air house party on the Poble Espanyol terrace, starting early so it works as the whole night. Expect it full, around a thousand: RA Pick, on four ticket sites and nearly sold out.
https://ra.co/events/2534107

2. Monumental Club Indie is Not Dead - Pony Bravo
🕘 Today 15:00 → 23:00 · 📍 Plaza Monumental de Barcelona
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €16.53
💬 Indie bands and DJs inside the old bullring from mid-afternoon; you go with friends, drink and drift between stage and bars. Featured in @planesenbarcelona's weekend list; expect a crowd in the low thousands.
https://dice.fm/event/mxyo9w-monumental-club-indie-is-not-dead-pony-bravo-21st-nov-plaza-monumental-de-barcelona-barcelona-tickets

3. TARDET en Sutton (tardeo)
🕘 Tonight 18:00 → 00:00 · 📍 Sutton, C/ Tuset 32
📊 Listed for Sat 21 Nov on YouBarcelona's tardeo agenda · ages 23–45
💶 €12 with a drink
💬 The Saturday tardeo you already go to: hits and dance from early evening, home by midnight. No headcount published, but it is a weekly session in a big club that regularly fills; expect several hundred.
https://youbarcelona.com/es/p/fiestas-de-tarde-barcelona

4. UNLOCKED pres. MVGRI (ANL)
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 BASSHAUS
📊 1,231 interested on RA · also on DICE
💶 €10
💬 The late option: a cheap techno night in a mid-size club with the highest interest count of any club listing tonight. Expect a full room of a few hundred; the RA and DICE listings both show it.
https://ra.co/events/2557201

5. Saturday Connections Night x Piano Club
🕘 Tonight 19:00 → 23:30 · 📍 LOCATION AND TICKETS ON LUMA
📊 93 going on Meetup · group has 15,726 members
💶 Free to RSVP
💬 Digital-nomad and startup crowd in a piano bar, in English: the one to pick if you want to meet new people rather than dance. Likely 70–100; the Meetup count and the organiser's Luma ticket figure agree.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-digital-nomads-community/events/317282972/

TOMORROW · Sun 22 Nov

1. FC Barcelona vs Villarreal — LaLiga
🕘 Sun 14:00 · 📍 Spotify Camp Nou
📊 LaLiga matchday 13 per FC Barcelona's official fixture list
💶 See club site
💬 By far the biggest crowd in the city on Sunday: a league match at the Camp Nou, tens of thousands. Check the club site for remaining seats; I could not confirm availability.
https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/tickets/football-tickets

2. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Sun · hours not stated (bars' own hours) · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 1,303 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend post · runs 13–29 Nov
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 A bar crawl: you walk between participating bars in Sant Antoni and get a tapa and a drink at each. One to do with friends you already have, not a place to meet people. How busy each bar gets I could not confirm.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

3. RHAPSODIA 3: FRANGLISH x TEKNO x YAPI.
🕘 Sun 17:00 → 23:00 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €49.58
💬 Afrobrunch's afternoon club session at Apolo with three live afrobeats and French rap acts, over by 23:00. No headcount published; it is a recurring party in a room for well over a thousand, so expect several hundred or more.
https://dice.fm/event/99e2m7-rhapsodia-3-franglish-x-tekno-x-yapi-22nd-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

4. Polyphia — Be Not Afraid World Tour
🕘 Sun 20:30 · 📍 Razzmatazz 1
📊 On the 26th-anniversary concert bill in @razzmatazzclubs' post · tickets on sale per Songkick
💶 From €47.50
💬 Instrumental prog-rock guitar band on a world tour in Razzmatazz's main room, which holds about two thousand. Expect a large, near-full room; resale prices are well above face value.
https://songkick.com/concerts/43277332-polyphia-at-razzmatazz

5. AYLA Tribal Rave BCN | Vol. 6
🕘 Sun 12:00 → 16:00 · 📍 Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hot…, Provençals del Poblenou
📊 182 guests on Luma
💶 €20
💬 A daytime dance party in a Poblenou hotel with coffee instead of a late night; easy to go alone and talk to people. About 150–200, based on the Luma guest list, which is marked near capacity.
https://luma.com/ayla.vol6

Scanned: Meetup 326 · RA 62 · DICE 26 · Xceed 18 · Eventbrite 158 · Luma 12 · Instagram 30 posts + 12 stories.
